name: Cloister
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Quiet and narrow: a short line, plain headings, em-dashes for nested bullets, borderless quotes in muted text and open tables. After Sanctum by José Daniel Mourão.

zh.description: 安静而窄：行宽短、标题朴素，嵌套列表用破折号，引用无边框、文字偏灰，表格不加框线。参考 José Daniel Mourão 的 Sanctum。
